_comment: Actor Factory convention, not read by Apify. After each deploy the Publisher sets these, with the title and description from actor.json, through the Apify API. Categories use Apify Store category names (for example JOBS, BUSINESS, DEVELOPER_TOOLS, ECOMMERCE).
seoTitle: ATS Jobs API: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Personio
seoDescription: Every open job from any company's Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable or Personio board, with salary ranges, as JSON or CSV. One run, five ATS.
